messages:
maria_support: FYI customer ACME (org-acme-42) escalated — their promo credits had staggered expiries (Mar/Apr/May) but invoice INV-2026-0043 shows charge for tokens that should've been offset. Dashboard shows 0 remaining credits, invoice charged $423.75. Customer says credits were 'applied' after invoice cutoff. Need triage.

david_billing: Can you paste org id + invoice link and the invoice period? Also any ledger ids or sample token timestamps?

maria_support: org-acme-42, invoice INV-2026-0043 (period 2025-04-01 -> 2025-04-30). Customer claims dashboard token total = 12,345 but invoice tokens = 15,678 (billed). Saw credits consumed timestamped 2025-05-02 in our ledger.

invoices-bot: ledger query results (summary) for org-acme-42: 
```
SELECT id, credit_type, amount, allocation_ts, expiry_ts, consumed_ts
FROM credit_ledger
WHERE org_id='org-acme-42' AND allocation_ts >= '2025-03-01' AND allocation_ts <= '2025-05-31'
ORDER BY allocation_ts;
-- sample rows returned:
-- id=cl_1001, type=promo, amount=500, allocation_ts=2025-03-01, expiry_ts=2025-03-31, consumed_ts=2025-03-15
-- id=cl_1002, type=promo, amount=500, allocation_ts=2025-04-01, expiry_ts=2025-04-30, consumed_ts=2025-05-02
-- id=cl_1003, type=promo, amount=500, allocation_ts=2025-05-01, expiry_ts=2025-05-31, consumed_ts=2025-05-02
```

ana_engineer: @maria_support thanks — that consumed_ts on 2025-05-02 is suspicious (post-invoice). Do we know whether consumption happens during invoice reconciliation or via the async "credit-apply" worker? Any delayed batch jobs ran?

maria_support: ops run a backfill job on 2025-05-02 after customer support asked to re-evaluate expired credits. Noted in runbook: job id bf-20250502.

ana_engineer: probable cause: credit-apply/backfill worker re-ran and applied older credits after invoice cutoff. Our invoice reconciliation uses snapshot at cutoff. If backfill applies credits after snapshot, invoice won't retroactively change. Repro steps I suggest:
```
# repro (dev env)
# 1) seed token events dated before cutoff
./tools/produce_tokens --org org-acme-42 --period 2025-04 --tokens 15678 --out tokens.json
# 2) run ledger worker delayed (simulate backfill)
./services/ledger-worker --replay tokens.json --delay-apply
# 3) run invoice reconcile
./tools/reconcile_invoices --org org-acme-42 --period 2025-04
# observe: reconcile does not pick post-cutoff consumed credits
```

maria_support: I can run the repro in staging if you want. Customer needs an interim fix — they're already billing dispute-ing.

lisa_prodops: short-term: we should issue a one-off credit for the delta and mark it as "billing adjustment" so customer invoicing matches. Long-term: change ordering rule for when ledger/backfill applies credits — enforce apply_ts <= invoice_cutoff for auto-apply or queue for next invoice rather than retroactively adjust consumed_ts. Also add a guard in reconciliation: if credits allocated before cutoff but consumed_ts > cutoff, reconcile should treat them as if consumed at allocation_ts when possible.

david_billing: Agreed. What's the delta amount to credit? Also need to create Billing ticket and issue customer-facing note.

maria_support: Reconciled numbers: billed delta = $423.75 (tokens difference 3,333 @ $0.12725/token). Customer wants the credit applied this billing cycle.

david_billing: Creating ticket and issuing one-off credit now. Ticket: Billing-TKT-789. Notifying accounts. @lisa_prodops can you schedule the ledger ordering change PR?

lisa_prodops: I'll open a PR to enforce credit-apply ordering by (expiry_ts asc, allocation_ts asc) and add a boolean to block late-consume in auto-backfill. ETA EOD tomorrow. :eyes:

ana_engineer: I'll add a test case in reconciliation e2e to simulate delayed backfill and expected behavior. Also will add logging to trace apply origin (auto vs manual/backfill) so billing ops can detect this faster.

maria_support: Customer notified — offered immediate one-off credit and eta for fix. Closing loop once PR & ticket done. :thumbsup:

invoices-bot: action recorded: Billing-TKT-789 created, credit $423.75 queued for application to org-acme-42.

david_billing: Thanks everyone — follow-up in ticket for postmortem and a short message for invoices' FAQ about backfills and invoice snapshots.
